answer.text: Valid certification as specified by SEBI (i.e. NISM Series-XXI-A)

explanation.text: **The Logic:** SEBI-specified certification (NISM XXI-A for PMS distributors) is mandatory. **The Trap:** Other qualifications alone don't meet regulatory requirements. **Cross-Exam Context:** Same in V-A for MF distributors (NISM V-A). **Distributor's Pro-Tip:** Track expiry of NISM certifications with 60-day renewal alerts.
